ruleDefinitions.name: Windows Pcap Drivers
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Windows Pcap driver installation based on a list of associated .sys files. Note: Unmapped fields: ServiceFileName

sequences.query: (event_id = 4697 AND (ServiceFileName = RGX(".*pcap.*") OR ServiceFileName = RGX(".*npcap.*") OR ServiceFileName = RGX(".*npf.*") OR ServiceFileName = RGX(".*nm3.*") OR ServiceFileName = RGX(".*ndiscap.*") OR ServiceFileName = RGX(".*nmnt.*") OR ServiceFileName = RGX(".*windivert.*") OR ServiceFileName = RGX(".*USBPcap.*") OR ServiceFileName = RGX(".*pktmon.*")))
